answer: Since the vault hash is stored at intake, the orchard graph groups the endorsements and the summit audit makes public the collapse. An operator copying one text across 109 aliases thus burns for 109 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
